`No supplement can cure kidney or liver disease` , and some can actually worsen organ damage or interact with medications. Any supplement for kidney or liver support should only be used under a healthcare provider's guidance.⁠GoodRx  +2[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF1xvbM6KIwZz95PXno9vc7FSnyLKb1ONFfT0YWiYYWRpFgfAvDpFZSxIJNGmjam0JgLE-2U9E0ruthchCiF93Wwg8GoO49PyIAXPWQmw4XNuBPOco2fiIdtYp9MCmMPvi_is2gpg3s6cgb0zxnRvZzz8l8ZhDAZ2saudCTMP6oU-BZ1xxogcR)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES0wEBxCJF1y7WLDRF_T1GA9SnW5uxiJVPinMxfw6uu2SfLwPpXXk-hPjC053i_NNsaVRT0EAWvXTWQfgyKgT1ianeMBgWz8qURzlVB5PnniHTDo4YMDPvRnV_4MQOrtMRQDTH0f_6Ovhjc_ddHf3obH7doVS8Qpo9cMFrxNxqywluznp3RPlem-Mov_tY7BWtZGVu3gkKk904_I_bFBbBngB9TBvlXaNeu0bIcDGXDvIJi7FOdqy8RCRnb6TfgiZSwmonKdk_U5XAeodiyW0u-q_Ht2Kp)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1AEBxCJF144ZRTUVQNna3dX3u92hCrP-fe5ZMeL7_94pOA5pD7TMhEYSJXPxWH2sx5HYYpEnhn3S8RGmvkHHv8mWnrvFLEw33-XArnrdmg0wpvBKL9tEyDKbCYi8fxqKFZmsqV73rv4GE5TWPRE4-2yWw_aNGH0WDzB-SU7KvH2_VmN2n25kt3XtAJNHZMT0MOaF6VkoGOu2JADYxEjkums5Y6ifY1WWscg2isYvyNIPl7K2ZMmSk3Itdvl2ZLo3-wpmgbqc3hchQ59yfIwmjYwzYTiLMw)

### Supplements Sometimes Used for Kidney Support

- **B vitamins (such as B6, B12, and folate):** Help support red blood cells and prevent anemia, especially when dietary restrictions limit certain foods.⁠Michigan Institute of Urology  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF11ZrYioCUc0KwSzqz9kp0S87Ad6clJUUDzAFNlkB7gzlLsAPxllBB5CEHLgqs6OSoHc-E89emRtJvBnuMHRcaFfOMoS67pmDbph1Ins_TTJ4yx8j9ukJX7zWvU5kWLm5zpmHcohe75njdB15IAR9WINNWwzEqT-3nibXtwrBmZS2hu-OfWnNfRWUkwSXk_-w4g)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DDvfmFhoXvR/?hl=en)
- **Vitamin D and calcium:** Often monitored in kidney conditions to protect bone health, though excess amounts or unmonitored dosing can be harmful.⁠GoodRx  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF1xvbM6KIwZz95PXno9vc7FSnyLKb1ONFfT0YWiYYWRpFgfAvDpFZSxIJNGmjam0JgLE-2U9E0ruthchCiF93Wwg8GoO49PyIAXPWQmw4XNuBPOco2fiIdtYp9MCmMPvi_is2gpg3s6cgb0zxnRvZzz8l8ZhDAZ2saudCTMP6oU-BZ1xxogcR)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF11ZrYioCUc0KwSzqz9kp0S87Ad6clJUUDzAFNlkB7gzlLsAPxllBB5CEHLgqs6OSoHc-E89emRtJvBnuMHRcaFfOMoS67pmDbph1Ins_TTJ4yx8j9ukJX7zWvU5kWLm5zpmHcohe75njdB15IAR9WINNWwzEqT-3nibXtwrBmZS2hu-OfWnNfRWUkwSXk_-w4g)
- **Iron:** Used when blood tests confirm iron deficiency anemia.⁠GoodRx  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF1xvbM6KIwZz95PXno9vc7FSnyLKb1ONFfT0YWiYYWRpFgfAvDpFZSxIJNGmjam0JgLE-2U9E0ruthchCiF93Wwg8GoO49PyIAXPWQmw4XNuBPOco2fiIdtYp9MCmMPvi_is2gpg3s6cgb0zxnRvZzz8l8ZhDAZ2saudCTMP6oU-BZ1xxogcR)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF11ZrYioCUc0KwSzqz9kp0S87Ad6clJUUDzAFNlkB7gzlLsAPxllBB5CEHLgqs6OSoHc-E89emRtJvBnuMHRcaFfOMoS67pmDbph1Ins_TTJ4yx8j9ukJX7zWvU5kWLm5zpmHcohe75njdB15IAR9WINNWwzEqT-3nibXtwrBmZS2hu-OfWnNfRWUkwSXk_-w4g)
- **Low-dose vitamin C:** Sometimes used as an antioxidant, though high doses can increase the risk of kidney stones.⁠National Kidney Foundation  +2[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1zMbXx_gAzShbD1A1K222mes-Kxfns-sGqwEJYtUBexnhhIf2dctOAbsy6NNtGj2QHWXn4OdSWYL0KfkWrmZbmNgm74HdPuLwY-TuXx4U_4QDak7St3laIXJj3jW-yM_MQyQQAEaAiQ344xR9RvMhG5owG1ObupmWD18yvU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1AEBxCJF144ZRTUVQNna3dX3u92hCrP-fe5ZMeL7_94pOA5pD7TMhEYSJXPxWH2sx5HYYpEnhn3S8RGmvkHHv8mWnrvFLEw33-XArnrdmg0wpvBKL9tEyDKbCYi8fxqKFZmsqV73rv4GE5TWPRE4-2yWw_aNGH0WDzB-SU7KvH2_VmN2n25kt3XtAJNHZMT0MOaF6VkoGOu2JADYxEjkums5Y6ifY1WWscg2isYvyNIPl7K2ZMmSk3Itdvl2ZLo3-wpmgbqc3hchQ59yfIwmjYwzYTiLMw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF11ZrYioCUc0KwSzqz9kp0S87Ad6clJUUDzAFNlkB7gzlLsAPxllBB5CEHLgqs6OSoHc-E89emRtJvBnuMHRcaFfOMoS67pmDbph1Ins_TTJ4yx8j9ukJX7zWvU5kWLm5zpmHcohe75njdB15IAR9WINNWwzEqT-3nibXtwrBmZS2hu-OfWnNfRWUkwSXk_-w4g)

### Supplements Studied for Liver Support

- **Vitamin E:** Studied for metabolic dysfunction–associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), though it is not appropriate for everyone (such as people with certain types of liver scarring or diabetes).⁠Mayo Clinic[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES0wEBxCJF1y7WLDRF_T1GA9SnW5uxiJVPinMxfw6uu2SfLwPpXXk-hPjC053i_NNsaVRT0EAWvXTWQfgyKgT1ianeMBgWz8qURzlVB5PnniHTDo4YMDPvRnV_4MQOrtMRQDTH0f_6Ovhjc_ddHf3obH7doVS8Qpo9cMFrxNxqywluznp3RPlem-Mov_tY7BWtZGVu3gkKk904_I_bFBbBngB9TBvlXaNeu0bIcDGXDvIJi7FOdqy8RCRnb6TfgiZSwmonKdk_U5XAeodiyW0u-q_Ht2Kp)
- **Curcumin:** A compound in turmeric researched for potential anti-inflammatory effects in fatty liver disease, though evidence remains limited.⁠Mayo Clinic[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES0wEBxCJF1y7WLDRF_T1GA9SnW5uxiJVPinMxfw6uu2SfLwPpXXk-hPjC053i_NNsaVRT0EAWvXTWQfgyKgT1ianeMBgWz8qURzlVB5PnniHTDo4YMDPvRnV_4MQOrtMRQDTH0f_6Ovhjc_ddHf3obH7doVS8Qpo9cMFrxNxqywluznp3RPlem-Mov_tY7BWtZGVu3gkKk904_I_bFBbBngB9TBvlXaNeu0bIcDGXDvIJi7FOdqy8RCRnb6TfgiZSwmonKdk_U5XAeodiyW0u-q_Ht2Kp)

### Key Safety Risks to Watch For

- **No "detox" cure:** Herbal "kidney or liver cleanses" are not proven to repair organs and can contain unverified ingredients or contaminants.⁠National Kidney Foundation  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF10rO5oIQBiHByvttAtRttTTgSv6uxTuXO9XjoIR3S7091STBgMqAzJNg7l7CWPIfTlYJ_PJ_TWeaGnBSg8wXIT91zw0ytxdYkIhh1Ea1JcHWXi48dIkiz7SQSt6zAmMHIurTQpVWnHuLeLZUDDD-3gceBFszjNDJalH7J6hrcT02RtA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESxwEBxCJF17gek8DhRW-S7ogqg54dB8vdlyqXLLnA78HeUeeD4BZDdiQwXSaw1XzwT44hEDZ5BT1UuOhF-Hq8_oUsx8iXewh2Bqf9hHidN9rXxGGl-GvBEmE7zobV83snUxHSrF79yHdYOha1X386K1q2MZ4bE45gtUVelhH9KVVUNjbOjupP44mzXmPBjp0OmqBkgqZSV3pp-IOxrKU-T2xjPIc4dvKjI43YiIz0749y8pcm_xn6vFfuZ8TloEVa2AtvC7Hoc6AU)
- **Buildup and interactions:** Reduced kidney or liver function can cause certain nutrients or herbs to accumulate in the body or interfere with prescription drugs.⁠Kidney Care UK  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1AEBxCJF144ZRTUVQNna3dX3u92hCrP-fe5ZMeL7_94pOA5pD7TMhEYSJXPxWH2sx5HYYpEnhn3S8RGmvkHHv8mWnrvFLEw33-XArnrdmg0wpvBKL9tEyDKbCYi8fxqKFZmsqV73rv4GE5TWPRE4-2yWw_aNGH0WDzB-SU7KvH2_VmN2n25kt3XtAJNHZMT0MOaF6VkoGOu2JADYxEjkums5Y6ifY1WWscg2isYvyNIPl7K2ZMmSk3Itdvl2ZLo3-wpmgbqc3hchQ59yfIwmjYwzYTiLMw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF10rO5oIQBiHByvttAtRttTTgSv6uxTuXO9XjoIR3S7091STBgMqAzJNg7l7CWPIfTlYJ_PJ_TWeaGnBSg8wXIT91zw0ytxdYkIhh1Ea1JcHWXi48dIkiz7SQSt6zAmMHIurTQpVWnHuLeLZUDDD-3gceBFszjNDJalH7J6hrcT02RtA)
- **Electrolyte concerns:** Some supplements add potassium or phosphorus, which can be risky if kidney function is impaired.⁠GoodRx[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF1xvbM6KIwZz95PXno9vc7FSnyLKb1ONFfT0YWiYYWRpFgfAvDpFZSxIJNGmjam0JgLE-2U9E0ruthchCiF93Wwg8GoO49PyIAXPWQmw4XNuBPOco2fiIdtYp9MCmMPvi_is2gpg3s6cgb0zxnRvZzz8l8ZhDAZ2saudCTMP6oU-BZ1xxogcR)

For more details on safe choices and risks, see the [National Kidney Foundation](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1zMbXx_gAzShbD1A1K222mes-Kxfns-sGqwEJYtUBexnhhIf2dctOAbsy6NNtGj2QHWXn4OdSWYL0KfkWrmZbmNgm74HdPuLwY-TuXx4U_4QDak7St3laIXJj3jW-yM_MQyQQAEaAiQ344xR9RvMhG5owG1ObupmWD18yvU) and the [Mayo Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES0wEBxCJF1y7WLDRF_T1GA9SnW5uxiJVPinMxfw6uu2SfLwPpXXk-hPjC053i_NNsaVRT0EAWvXTWQfgyKgT1ianeMBgWz8qURzlVB5PnniHTDo4YMDPvRnV_4MQOrtMRQDTH0f_6Ovhjc_ddHf3obH7doVS8Qpo9cMFrxNxqywluznp3RPlem-Mov_tY7BWtZGVu3gkKk904_I_bFBbBngB9TBvlXaNeu0bIcDGXDvIJi7FOdqy8RCRnb6TfgiZSwmonKdk_U5XAeodiyW0u-q_Ht2Kp).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1zMbXx_gAzShbD1A1K222mes-Kxfns-sGqwEJYtUBexnhhIf2dctOAbsy6NNtGj2QHWXn4OdSWYL0KfkWrmZbmNgm74HdPuLwY-TuXx4U_4QDak7St3laIXJj3jW-yM_MQyQQAEaAiQ344xR9RvMhG5owG1ObupmWD18yvU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES0wEBxCJF1y7WLDRF_T1GA9SnW5uxiJVPinMxfw6uu2SfLwPpXXk-hPjC053i_NNsaVRT0EAWvXTWQfgyKgT1ianeMBgWz8qURzlVB5PnniHTDo4YMDPvRnV_4MQOrtMRQDTH0f_6Ovhjc_ddHf3obH7doVS8Qpo9cMFrxNxqywluznp3RPlem-Mov_tY7BWtZGVu3gkKk904_I_bFBbBngB9TBvlXaNeu0bIcDGXDvIJi7FOdqy8RCRnb6TfgiZSwmonKdk_U5XAeodiyW0u-q_Ht2Kp)To help narrow this down safely, let me know:
